title: Program Controls / Project Planner
description:
**About K1 Industries**  
For the first time in decades, power demand growth in the US has jumped 5x, driving multi-year lead times for critical power infrastructure. K1 builds and deploys modular gas turbine power packages at scale, now.

**The role**
------------

K1 is hiring a Program Controls / Project Planner to maintain the integrated schedule that connects design, procurement, manufacturing, testing, site readiness, and deployment. Working under the direction of the Head of Programs, you will turn inputs from teams across K1 into a clear, current view of milestones, dependencies, and delivery risks.

We need someone who can get beyond collecting status updates: understand how work fits together, challenge unsupported dates, and identify what needs to happen next to keep the program moving. You will maintain the schedule and change records, make downstream impacts visible, and give the Head of Programs and the workstream owners reliable information for decisions and follow-through.

**What the role owns**
----------------------

* **Integrated program schedule:** Build and maintain the design-to-deployment schedule across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, test, construction, commissioning, and delivery. Connect workstream plans through clear dependencies, milestones, and accountable owners.
* **Planning and schedule updates:** Work with team leads to define activities, durations, handoffs, and completion criteria. Establish a regular update cadence and verify progress against actual deliverables. Keep near-term work detailed and longer-term assumptions visible.
* **Critical path and delivery risks:** Identify the activities and dependencies driving key milestones. Track schedule float, constraints, and emerging delays, and flag their downstream impact early. Work with owners to develop recovery options for review by the Head of Programs.
* **Change tracking:** Maintain a record of proposed and approved changes to scope, sequencing, and milestone dates.
